description: This file defines classes and methods for managing OTA (Over-The-Air) update jobs, including database interactions, process management, and job information encapsulation.

classes.name: JobInfo
classes.description: Data class representing information about an OTA job, including methods for converting to dictionary formats and reading build info.

classes.name: DependencyError
classes.description: Custom exception class for dependency-related errors.

classes.name: ProcessesManagement
classes.description: Class managing OTA process execution, dependency checks, and database interactions for OTA jobs.

methods.name: check_external_dependencies
methods.description: Static method to verify presence of Java and zip commands.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing database and directory structure, and checking dependencies.

methods.name: insert_database
methods.description: Insert a JobInfo instance into the database.

methods.name: get_status_by_ID
methods.description: Retrieve job status by ID as a JobInfo instance.

methods.name: get_status
methods.description: Retrieve all job statuses as a list of JobInfo.

methods.name: update_status
methods.description: Update the status and finish time of a job in the database.

methods.name: ota_run
methods.description: Run OTA process as a subprocess, monitor completion, and update status.

methods.name: ota_generate
methods.description: Prepare and initiate OTA generation process based on provided arguments, then record in database.
